title: AD - Act on risky user-account behaviour
description: Every 15 min: password spray -> SecOps + watchlist; tier-0 group change -> ServiceNow change check + page on-call; lockout storm -> service desk with caller device.

detect_password_spray.name: detect_password_spray
detect_password_spray.description: 4625 / 4771 failures on 10+ accounts from one source (last 15 min)

input.query:
fetch logs, from: now()-15m
| filter matchesValue(winlog.eventid, "4625") or matchesValue(winlog.eventid, "4771")
| filterOut matchesPhrase(content, "The EventSystem sub system is suppressing duplicate event log entries")
| parse content, """DATA 'Account For Which Logon Failed:' DATA 'Account Name:' SPACE? LD:acct_4625 EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Source Network Address:' SPACE? LD:src_4625 EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Account Information:' DATA 'Account Name:' SPACE? LD:acct_4771 EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Client Address:' SPACE? LD:src_4771 EOL"""
| fieldsAdd account = lower(trim(coalesce(acct_4625, acct_4771)))
| fieldsAdd source = replaceString(trim(coalesce(src_4625, src_4771)), "::ffff:", "")
| filterOut isNull(source) or source == "-" or source == "::1" or source == "127.0.0.1"
| filterOut isNull(account) or account == "-" or endsWith(account, "$")
| summarize failures = count(), accounts = countDistinct(account), sample_accounts = collectDistinct(account, maxLength: 10),
    dcs = collectDistinct(host.name), first_seen = min(timestamp), last_seen = max(timestamp), by: {source}
| filter accounts >= 10
| sort accounts desc
| limit 50

input.subject: [AD] Password spray from {{ result("detect_password_spray").records | length }} source(s)

watchlist_spray_sources.name: watchlist_spray_sources
watchlist_spray_sources.description: Add each source to the watchlist (bizevent)

input.query:
fetch logs, from: now()-15m
| filter matchesValue(winlog.eventid, "4728") or matchesValue(winlog.eventid, "4732") or matchesValue(winlog.eventid, "4756")
| filterOut matchesPhrase(content, "The EventSystem sub system is suppressing duplicate event log entries")
| parse content, """DATA 'Subject:' DATA 'Account Name:' SPACE? LD:changed_by EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Member:' DATA 'Account Name:' SPACE? LD:member_dn EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Group Name:' SPACE? LD:group_name EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Group Domain:' SPACE? LD:group_domain EOL"""
| fieldsAdd group_name = trim(group_name), group_domain = trim(group_domain), changed_by = trim(changed_by), member_dn = trim(member_dn)
| filter in(lower(group_name), array("domain admins", "enterprise admins", "schema admins", "administrators", "account operators", "backup operators", "server operators", "print operators", "dnsadmins", "group policy creator owners", "key admins", "enterprise key admins"))
| fieldsAdd member = if(startsWith(member_dn, "CN="), substring(member_dn, from: 3, to: indexOf(member_dn, ",")), else: member_dn)
| fieldsAdd event_id = toString(winlog.eventid), dc = host.name
| fields timestamp, dc, event_id, group = group_name, group_domain, member, member_dn, changed_by
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50

check_change_window.name: check_change_window
check_change_window.description: Look up an approved ServiceNow change

page_oncall_group_change.name: page_oncall_group_change
page_oncall_group_change.description: Page on-call with the change check result

input.subject: [AD][PAGE] Tier-0 group change: {{ result("check_change_window").without_change }} without an approved change

detect_lockout_storm.name: detect_lockout_storm
detect_lockout_storm.description: Repeated 4740 for one user (3+ in the last hour) with caller device

input.query:
fetch logs, from: now()-60m
| filter matchesValue(winlog.eventid, "4740")
| filterOut matchesPhrase(content, "The EventSystem sub system is suppressing duplicate event log entries")
| parse content, """DATA 'Account That Was Locked Out:' DATA 'Account Name:' SPACE? LD:account EOL"""
| parse content, """DATA 'Caller Computer Name:' SPACE? LD:caller EOL"""
| fieldsAdd account = trim(account), caller = trim(caller)
| filterOut isNull(account) or account == "-"
| summarize lockouts = count(), devices = collectDistinct(caller), dcs = collectDistinct(host.name),
    first_seen = min(timestamp), last_seen = max(timestamp), by: {account}
| filter lockouts >= 3
| sort lockouts desc
| limit 50

notify_service_desk_lockouts.name: notify_service_desk_lockouts
notify_service_desk_lockouts.description: Tell the service desk which device is causing it

input.subject: [AD] Lockout storm: {{ result("detect_lockout_storm").records | length }} account(s)
